aaa.ui.settings_video_renderer_note: Renderer & Quality: Automatic selects the best backend and steps down after a failed boot; OpenGL or ANGLE helps older PC drivers. Automatic quality adjusts detail to hold steady frame times; named presets lock detail.
aaa.ui.settings_video_smooth_note: Frame pacing & Map load: keep Smooth time on so daily ticks spread across frames without stalling the camera. Lowering Map render resolution or turning off 3D terrain relief cuts GPU load without changing gameplay.
aaa.ui.settings_video_mobile_note: Mobile & Diagnostics: Android uses Compatibility (GLES3) by default to avoid Mali/Exynos Vulkan crashes while keeping all map styles. Use Report a problem below on PC; boot_trace.txt and last_crash.txt are written to logs/ (on Android: Android/data/com.bayterealization.dealorforce/files/logs/).
aaa.ui.settings_interface_smooth_note: Map smoothness & overlays: Smooth the map draws vector-crisp borders instead of raw texels; turn it off on slower GPUs to show the authored raster directly. Clouds, Fog-of-war mist, Trade, and Events only change visuals.
